title: POTV ONE Starter Accessories Kit
description:
Who is the “Starter” Accessories Bundle for?

The POTV ONE Starter Bundle is a great choice if you’re curious about POTV ONE accessories but not sure where to start. It includes everything you need to level up your ONE vaporizer experience, with room to expand when you’re ready.

Each accessory upgrades the experience, from grinding and packing to loading, cleaning, and everything in between.

Looking for a little more? Check out our Advanced Bundle.

POTV Globe Glass stem

Enjoy cooler, smoother vapor with the POTV Globe Glass Stem. Longer sessions and higher temps can get a bit harsh, but this stem is designed to fix that.

Its globe shape, cooling dimples, and extended vapor path help condition the vapor for some of the coolest hits you can get from a dry stem.

POTV GrindVac Container

Vaporizers work best with ground herbs, and herbs can be pretty smelly. The POTV GrindVac Container solves both issues with an all-in-one grinder and airtight storage solution.

Grind your herbs straight into the smell-proof compartment to keep everything fresh and discreet. It also has a built-in lock to secure your stash and a hidden stir tool for easy stirring or scraping.

Set of 4 POTV ONE Dosing Capsules

Preload these ONE Dosing Capsules with your herbs, then pop them into your vaporizer’s oven for quick, mess-free sessions. They’re perfect for back-to-back sessions with minimal downtime and help keep your vape cleaner for longer.

POTV ONE Capsule Caddy

Take your preloaded sessions on the go with the POTV ONE Dosing Caddy! This tough, metallic caddy holds up to four dosing capsules and keeps them secure with a smell-proof, waterproof seal. Just pack your capsules, stash them in the caddy, and use the keychain ring to attach it to your key ring, belt loop, or bag for easy travel.

Replacement Screens and Alcohol Swabs

Keep your ONE running smoothly with a set of replacement screens. These screens sit under the glass adapter to keep herbs from entering the mouthpiece, but they’ll collect debris over time. A quick screen swap will save you from deep cleanings.

For tougher cleanups, use Snaps prefilled cotton swaps to clean a messy ONE oven chamber. Just snap the blue line end to release alcohol to the other side and wipe away stubborn residue.

Cleaning Disclaimer: DO NOT insert anything into the dimpled stem when cleaning. Clean with warm water and a mild grease-cutting dishwashing detergent such as Dawn or isopropyl alcohol.

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories returned on their own. However, your items are eligible for return through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.
